subject: general
question: Ramnad V Raghavan is associated with which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Mridangam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ramnad V Raghavan** is associated with the **Mridangam,** which is a percussion instrument commonly used in **Carnatic music.**
 
• In **Madurai, Tamil Nadu**, India, he was born into P. Vaidyanatha Ayyar and Brhannayaki, in the Kooniyur village of the Tirunelveli district.
 
• Renowned Carnatic vocalist** Ramnad Krishnan** was his older brother.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **flute** is a **wind instrument** that is used in many different types of music, including **classical, folk, and popular music.**

 
 
• The bansuri gained international recognition thanks to the performances and compositions of Indian flutist **Hariprasad Chaurasia.**
 
 
 
• The **sitar** is a **stringed instrument** that is commonly used in Hindustani classical music.
 
 
• Indian musician, sitarist, composer, and National Orchestra of India founder** Ravi Shankar** had a significant impact in promoting Western awareness of Indian music.
 
 
 
• The **sarod **is another type of** stringed instrument **that is also commonly used in Hindustani classical music.
 
 
• In India, **Amjad Ali Khan** is a well-known sarod player.
